lines.text: David swore he would not enter his house until he found a place for the LORD.
The people heard the ark was in Bethel, found it in Jaar's fields, and urged each other to worship.
The LORD swore David's descendants would sit on his throne forever if his sons kept His covenant and testimony.
He will clothe Zion's priests with salvation, has prepared a lamp for His anointed, and will clothe enemies with shame.
